name: Expose UUID
description: Adds a 'UUID' text field to every entity edit form for users holding the 'edit uuid' permission, showing (and letting them change) the entity's UUID; changing a UUID can break references, so grant the permission only to trusted admins.
project_description: Drupal comes with the Configuration Manager. When you export configuration it exports references to placed custom blocks (and similar content), but not the blocks themselves, so you must recreate them by hand on each environment, where they receive a different UUID and end up as 'missing blocks'. Expose UUID adds an editable UUID field to entity edit forms (gated by the 'edit uuid' permission) so an admin can align those UUIDs across environments through the standard admin interface.
